summary: Covers the happy-path profile update (with persistence verified via reload) and the two client-side required-field validations the form actually enforces (First Name, Last Name). The form only validates First/Last Name, Address, City, State, and Zip Code client-side; Phone Number has no validation span in the DOM, so no case asserts a phone validation message.

cases.title: A happy-path update persists the new address and phone number
steps: Fill every field with new Faker-generated values
cases.expected: The success panel is shown, and every field reflects the new values after reload.

cases.title: An empty First Name is rejected client-side
steps: Clear First Name, fill everything else
cases.expected: "First name is required." appears inline; the success panel never shows, meaning no request was sent.

cases.title: An empty Last Name is rejected client-side
steps: Clear Last Name, fill everything else
cases.expected: "Last name is required." appears inline; the success panel never shows, meaning no request was sent.
